title: "V6010 non_std_effect_in_main"
description: "main's effect row may contain only std effects, because only they have host root handlers (design §9)."
---

An error from the `capability` phase. `sakura explain V6010` prints this explanation offline.

`main`'s effect row may contain only std effects, because only they have host root handlers
(design §9). Handle user effects inside `main` with `with`.

Wrong:

```sakura
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Db} { let _ = Db.count() }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} {
  with empty_db() { Console.print("{Db.count()} rows") }
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V6010_non_std_effect_in_main.fixed.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V6010_non_std_effect_in_main.fixed.sakura), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
effect Db {
  fn count() -> Int
}

fn empty_db() -> Handler<Db> {
  handler Db {
    fn count() { 0 }
  }
}

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { with empty_db() { Console.print("{Db.count()} rows") } }
```
